rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REWARDS FOR INFORMATION CONCERNING TERRORISM PROGRAM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: There is hereby established a Rewards for Information Concerning Terrorism Program under the Department of Justice to be administered by the Secretary of Justice, which is authorized to grant rewards to individuals who furnishes information leadingto: (1) the arrest or conviction of any person or persons for the commission of an act of terrorism as defined in this Act, within the territorial jurisdiction of the Philippines; (2) the arrest or conviction of any person or persons for conspiring or attempting to commit an act of terrorism as defined in this Act, within the territorial jurisdiction of the Philippines; (3) the prevention, frustration, favorable resolution of an act of terrorism as defined in this Act, within the territorial jurrisdiction of the Philippines; and (4) the prevention of entry into the territorial jurisdiction of the Philippines of any person or persons known or suspected to be terrorists or members of any terrorist organization.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05923

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO LIBERALIZE THE OPERATIONS OF RURAL BANKS AMENDING FOR THAT PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7353, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE NEW RURAL BANKS ACT OF 1992 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: The rural banks play a major role in socio-economic development of the countryside, as more than eighty percent (80%) of rural banks' clients are within the poverty line. The rural Banks Act of 1992 or Republic Act No. 7353 was passed inrecognition of the need to make credit available and accessible in the rural areas. Due to political and economic crisis, rural banks have not recovered, remained in the state where they were in the 1980's and the poverty in the countryside widened.> This bill claims to resolve the issues, plug the loopholes, decrease financial cost of borrowers and re-direct the flow of funds to the countryside that diluted the real intent of R.A. 7353.

rows.abstract: "Original Pilipino Music Act of 2002". There shall be a gradual increase of Original Pilipino Musical compositions to be played or broadcast over the airwaves, by radio stations with musical format programs, to reach a total of Fity (50%) percent oftotal number of songs played every clock hour within a three (3) year period. The schedule of the gradual increase shall be the following: (1) For the first year from the date of the effectivity of this Act, an increase of THIRTY (30%) PERCENT of total osngs played per clockhour shall be Original Pilino musical compositions; (2) For the second year rom the date of the effectivity of this Act, an increase of FORTY (40%) PERCENT of total songs played per clockhour shall be Original Pilipino musiccal compositions; and (3) Within the third year from the date of the effectivity of this Act, the total increase of FIFTY (50%) PERCENT of the total songs per clockhour shall be Original Pilipino musical compositions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2002-09-04
